system.description:
Half-heard sounds and glimpsed motions begin to stalk your victim, the surreal debris of his own buried fears and guilt bleeding into the waking world.

Expend one Blood Trait and engage your victim in a Social Challenge (retest Empathy). On success he suffers fleeting nightmares often plucked from his own subconscious — you may choose which sense they affect — and is afflicted with the derangement Schizophrenia for the remainder of the evening. Your hand in it is not immediately evident; the victim should roleplay his new terrors.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
